messages:
sara_sales: Quick ask — AtlasHealth POC needs a temporary per-token credit and lower min charge to get legal to sign. Can deal-desk/finance triage today?

evansales: quick summary from discovery: 30-day POC, estimated 3-4M tokens total, will run in hosted us-west, heavy embeddings + chat. Customer requests per-token $0.00012 (standard $0.00025) and min_charge $1,500 (standard $5,000).

joel_se: Re: workload — confirmed. Latency/throughput tested in our staging, no perf issues. Risk is cost if they spike. Recommend hard cap and auto-revert.

priya_cs: Customer is price-sensitive and wants quick turn. If we can offer a smaller min and short window they'll commit to a pilot next quarter.

mike_finance: Need a back-of-envelope delta. Quick calc in case it's helpful:
```
standard_rate = 0.00025
override = 0.00012
tokens = 3_000_000
delta = (standard_rate - override) * tokens = 0.00013 * 3,000,000 = $390
```
That seems manageable, but we should model a 5M worst-case. At 5M delta ~= $650.

anya_dealdesk: I'm provisionally OK with an exception if we put guardrails in place. Required guardrails: 1) 30-day max, 2) explicit 5M token cap, 3) one-time credit applied up front, 4) auto-revert to standard pricing after cap/timeout, 5) pay method on file. Also add clause: no stacking with other discounts.

billing-bot: billing-bot created billing override draft: https://billing.internal/redwood/overrides/ATLAS-POC-1876 — workflow awaiting deal-desk + finance approval.

sara_sales: @anya_dealdesk will those guardrails be sufficient for legal/finance? I can add wording to the SOW: 'Temporary usage pricing applies for the first 30 days or until 5,000,000 tokens consumed, whichever occurs first; standard pricing resumes automatically thereafter.'

anya_dealdesk: Yes, that wording is fine. Also require: 'no retro refunds' and 'customer agrees to automated monitoring and will be billed if usage exceeds cap at standard rate.'

mike_finance: Finance ok with $1.5k min for this 30-day, 5M-capped POC. Please log the override in SFDC under the opportunity and mark ARR impact as nominal. :white_check_mark:

sara_sales: Thanks team — I'll update the SOW and submit the override PR. Aiming to get final sign-off within 2 hours. I'll ping here when submitted. :rocket:
